title: DeterminantSplitLinearMaps
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $A\xrightarrow{f}B\xrightarrow{g}C$ a short complex of sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $n=r+s$ and assume $A$ is finite locally free of rank $r$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. Let $U$ be open and $e:B|_U\simeq A|_U\oplus C|_U$ satisfy $ef|_U=\mathrm{inl}$ and $\mathrm{pr}_2e=g|_U$. For each $W\subseteq U$ let $l_W:C(W)\to B(W)$ be any function with $g_W l_W=\mathrm{id}$. Exterior powers mean [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power]. There is exactly one family of $\mathcal O_X(W)$-linear maps $d_W:(\bigwedge^r A\otimes\bigwedge^s C)(W)\to(\bigwedge^n B)(W)$ commuting with every restriction $W\supseteq Z$, and satisfying $d_W((\bigwedge a_i)\otimes(\bigwedge b_j))=\bigwedge(f(a_i),l_W(b_j))$ for all tuples $a\in A(W)^r$ and $b\in C(W)^s$, first the $r$ included entries then the $s$ lifted entries, reindexed using $n=r+s$. No rank hypothesis on $C$ or invertibility conclusion is asserted.

source.place: Proof of (*), determinant paragraph, split exterior comparison and independence of quotient lifts

proof.text: Use the open-restriction adjunction unit, bijective on sections W contained in U, to evaluate each restricted morphism as an O_X(W)-linear map. Prove identity, composition, addition and naturality of evaluation. Evaluate biprod.inr followed by e.inv to obtain a natural linear lift t. Apply the local exterior tensor pairing construction to f and t, producing the natural family d and its formula for these linear lifts.

The splitting identity (e.hom followed by fst) followed by f plus g followed by (inr followed by e.inv) equals the identity. Evaluate this identity on each subopen. It proves that t is a right inverse to g and that every section killed by g is the image under f of its first coordinate. Thus t(b)-l(b) is such an image. Replace lifted entries one at a time, using induction on the finite set of replaced indices and multilinearity. Each error term vanishes by the rank wedge-zero theorem. This establishes the given arbitrary-lift formula.

For uniqueness compare two natural linear families on pure tensors of wedges, where their displayed formulas agree. Prove one general induction lemma for any locally surjective morphism from a module presheaf Q to a module sheaf E and sectionwise spanning generators: the image sieve is covering, and span induction establishes the property on its local preimages. Apply it to the exterior sheafification unit first in the second factor and then in the first, using exteriorPower.ιMulti_span. Apply it to the tensor sheafification unit composed with the tensor comparison inverse, using TensorProduct.span_tmul_eq_top. At each local extension, naturality and separatedness identify the original sections. Use PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply and tmulSection_map directly for restriction compatibility. Extensionality proves equality of the families. The generalized induction helper is proved locally; no duplicate special-case helper or additional hypothesis is introduced.

proof_origin.note: Lean proof: local adjunction evaluation, finite replacement induction for lift independence, and one generalized locally-surjective generated induction for exterior and tensor uniqueness. Repair removes all four duplicate helpers; no import cycle or public interface change. The pairing construction remains a generic split theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem determinant_split_linear_maps_exists {X : Scheme.{v}}
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (r₁ r₂ r₃ : ℕ) (hr : r₂ = r₁ + r₃)
    [S.X₁.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r₁]
    (U : X.Opens)
    (e : S.X₂.restrict U.ι ≅ S.X₁.restrict U.ι ⊞ S.X₃.restrict U.ι)
    (hf : (restrictFunctor U.ι).map S.f ≫ e.hom = biprod.inl)
    (hg : e.hom ≫ biprod.snd = (restrictFunctor U.ι).map S.g)
    (l : ∀ (W : X.Opens), W ≤ U → S.X₃.val.obj (op W) → S.X₂.val.obj (op W))
    (hl : ∀ W hW b, S.g.val.app (op W) (l W hW b) = b) :
    ∃! (d : ∀ (W : X.Opens), W ≤ U →
      (exteriorSheaf S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₃ r₃).val.obj (op W)
        →ₗ[X.presheaf.obj (op W)] (exteriorSheaf S.X₂ r₂).val.obj (op W)),
      (∀ W hW (a : Fin r₁ → S.X₁.val.obj (op W))
        (b : Fin r₃ → S.X₃.val.obj (op W)),
        d W hW (tmulSection (exteriorSheafSection S.X₁ r₁ W a)
          (exteriorSheafSection S.X₃ r₃ W b)) =
        exteriorSheafSection S.X₂ r₂ W
          (fun i ↦ Fin.append (fun j ↦ S.f.val.app (op W) (a j))
            (fun j ↦ l W hW (b j)) (Fin.cast hr i))) ∧
      (∀ (W Z : X.Opens) (hW : W ≤ U) (hZW : Z ≤ W) y,
        (exteriorSheaf S.X₂ r₂).val.map (homOfLE hZW).op (d W hW y) =
          d Z (hZW.trans hW)
            ((exteriorSheaf S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₃ r₃).val.map
              (homOfLE hZW).op y))
